Help us feed you!

Becoming a HolmGoods member supports Chaseholm in a number of important ways.  Your purchase helps us make sure we can stay in the game of growing good food, using climate supportive practices and taking care of the people, animals and land that we love.  Become a Holmie today!  

FAQ

Q; What is Holmgoods?

HolmGoods is Chasehom Farm’s meat and dairy CSA. CSA stands for Community Supported Agriculture. By joining HolmGoods, you are entering a relationship with our farm and making a financial commitment that immensely helps us! The Hudson Valley CSA Coalition website has lots of great information on the history of CSAs and what it means to become a part of one.

Q: How do I receive my HolmGoods share?

HolmGoods is a self-serve, year-round, bi-weekly CSA. We have fridges and freezers set up at over ten locations throughout the Hudson Valley where you can pick up your share every other week sometime during a several day pick-up window. We try to be as flexible and convenient as possible! 

Q: What types of shares are available? 

We have two share sizes: small and large. The default small share includes one yogurt, one cheese, and 2-3 cuts of beef and pork. The default large share includes two yogurts, two cheeses, and 3-4 cuts of beef and pork. However! We want HolmGoods to be as useful to your household as we can and so we offer customization. You can sign up for a share that consistently includes or excludes certain items (i.e. Meat Only, No Yogurt, Dairy Only, etc.) and you can also customize your share to include exactly what you want each time. 

Q: What’s special about HolmGoods?

Probably the most special thing about HolmGoods is that we don’t sell our beef or pork anywhere except our own farmstore and to food sovereignty partners. So HolmGoods is one of the only avenues for you to access Chaseholm beef and pork. We also know how important the quality of food is, and with HolmGoods, you can feel confident that everything coming from our farm to your fridge is of the highest quality and was raised with ethical standards and lots of care. 

Q: What if I want to pause or cancel my share? 

HolmGoods has become an integral part of our business and your commitment to the farm and the share means the world to us. While there is no specific time commitment necessary for HolmGoods, we hope that you’ll love it and want to make it a monthly part of your household. Each payment cycle covers two shares, so you’re only committing for two shares at a time. You can pause or cancel in between payment cycles at any time. 

Q: I’m a vegetarian but I love this idea and my family eats a fair bit of dairy for protein.  Can I have an all dairy share?  

Yes! We have a Small, All Dairy share which offers 1-2 yogurts and 1-2 cheeses each delivery. 

Q: How do I sign up for HolmGoods? 

Right here!

Q: I have more questions. How can I get in touch?

We’re always happy to talk about the share and answer any questions. The best way to get in touch is to email holmgoods@chaseholmfarm.com.

100% grass-fed raw milk

We have a license to sell Raw Milk from our farm.  Our milk is bottled in glass, fresh from our grass based herd of Jerseys and Holsteins.  Our milk is high in butterfat so it has a very full and sweet taste.  It is also a nutrient-dense food; cows grazing grass make milk with a more balanced fatty acid profile and higher levels of Conjugated Linoleic Acid (CLA). 

Our milk is available in half gallon and quart sizes.  You'll find it in the Farm store  every single day, we’re open from 8am-8pm.

FARM STORE HOURS: OPEN FROM 8 AM- 8 PM 7 DAYS A WEEK.

A note on A2A2:  Many folks are curious about this.  I have been breeding for A2A2 since I took over the family farm in 2013.  I have not yet genetic tested my herd for A2 so  I can’t guarantee that we are 100% A2, I am sure we are not, however, I bet our herd has a far higher incidence of A2 cows than the average herd would.  I’m guessing close to 90% at this point! Many people tell me that they can digest our milk or thank us for making milk that allows them to partake in dairy again but of course that is only their experience.  

100% grass-fed yogurt

Chaseholm started making yogurt in 2017 with the help of Hawthorne Valley Farm.  We bring our milk there to have it processed into our own unique yogurt recipe.   Our yogurt is made with whole milk and you'll see a distinctive layer of cream that rises to the top of each container.  Depending on the time of year and how much growing grass the cows are eating the cream might be a golden yellow, showing you it's nutritional benefits right on top.   Try our yogurt for breakfast or maybe desert or stirred into soups, dollopped onto curries or stews. 

We have a simple whole milk yogurt and a delicious maple yogurt.  (our maple yogurt is still simple, the only added ingredient is locally harvest organic maple syrup)

100% grass-fed beef

In our management-intensive production system we are constantly making decisions for the health of our cows and of our farmscape's ecosystem.  A byproduct of those choices is meat with the wonderful flavor and the highest nutritional profile possible.  Utilizing every bit of these special creatures feels like the deepest way to honor their life.

We raise a dedicated beef herd of Red Devons and British Whites, two breeds that do well on 100% grass.  These cows graze all day in summer and in the winter times they eat hay we make on the farm.  The fat of grass-fed animals has a more balanced omega 6 to omega 3 ratio and higher levels of Conjugated Linoleic Acids (CLAs).  People are starting to realize that those are important for keeping our human organisms humming along at optimal health. 

We have all sorts of cuts available in the farm store and through out CSA program called HolmGoods! Come through and check it out! 

cows are alchemists ...
heritage breed pork

We raise our heritage breed pigs on organic grain from Stonehouse Farm, one of our neighbors in the Hudson Valley that is also working to understand the intricacies of drawing carbon from the atmosphere back into the soil. 

 In the winter we bed them heavily with hay so that they can root around and exercise all their pig instincts while also staying cozy and warm.   You can visit them in their winter barn when you visit the farm store!

Frequently Asked Questions

HOW DO I GET RAW MILK 

We are legally only allowed to sell raw milk from the farm, so you’ll have to come visit our farm store. Raw milk is currently available seven days per week. 

HOW LONG DOES RAW MILK STAY GOOD FOR?

If you KEEP IT COLD, your milk will be good for at least 7 days, and after that it will start to sour, aka start turn into cheese! You can use it like buttermilk in a recipe, or check out these other ways to use it up. 

WHEN CAN I GET PASTEURIZED MILK, CAN I EXPECT IT IN THE STORE?

We don’t currently bottle pasteurized milk due to infrastructure limitations. You can pasteurize your raw milk at home using these instructions. 

CAN I VISIT THE FARM?

Yes! You can come to the farm store and wave to our cows or schedule a tour for a more in depth visit. For information on when our seasonal events, check back here. 

WHAT DOES GRASS-FED MEAN? 

Grass-fed means our cows are 100% grass-fed for their entire life - no grain, no soy, no GMO feeds. All grass all year. You can read more about our methods here. 

WHERE CAN I BUY YOUR PRODUCTS?

​

You can purchase our milk, cheese, yogurt, and meat at our farm store, or purchase our dairy products at these local farmers markets, or find selected products at these grocery stores. See our Purchase tab for more details.

DO YOU SHIP?

​

Yes and No.  You can get our cheeses shipped to you! Cheese travels pretty well but we do not ship our other farm products.  If you would like to order cheese to be shipped head here. 

DO YOU OFFER HOME DELIVERY?

We do not offer home delivery but you can pre-order items for pick up at our farm store or join our CSA that we deliver to locations throughout the Hudson Valley.  Find more about our CSA here. 

  

HOW IS YOUR MEAT PACKAGED / PRICED?

​

Most of our products are sold by the pound. Because every animal is a little different, not all packages weigh the same amount. We've done our best to provide the average weight range, package quantity, and approximate total price of each of our products. Find all that info alongside our list of current offerings HERE. 

WHY IS YOUR BEEF/PORK ALWAYS FROZEN?

​

Our cows and pigs are processed at a USDA-inspected facility. Once they have cut and packaged our meat, everything is put directly into their deep freezer, and by the time we get the call to pick it up, it is typically frozen. It is very difficult for small volume farms like ours to manage fresh meat in a way that optimizes quality and reduces waste.

WHAT DO YOU FEED YOUR LIVESTOCK?

​

All of our animals are grass-fed. Our cows are 100% grass-fed and finished, and we supplement the diet of our pigs with whey, a byproduct of making Chaseholm Creamery Cheese, and an antibiotic and hormone-free, non-GMO ration.

DO YOU SLAUGHTER YOUR OWN ANIMALS?​

​

No, per New York State law, our cows and pigs are all slaughtered at  local USDA-inspected facilities.

RAW MILK 

Chaseholm Farm is a New York certified raw milk dairy. We bottle fresh milk exclusively for our on farm store and it’s available 7 days a week. Our dairy herd is 100% grass-fed and certified organic.

100% GRASS-FED YOGURT

100% Grass-Fed Yogurt is made using our grass-fed whole milk and live probiotic cultures.  The yogurt is whole milk cream top and comes in plain and maple quarts.   

GRASS-FED BEEF

Ground and Stew Beef from cows raised in our 100% grass-fed system.
